summary:
Reviewed w245's commits f968f32a and 7f37149d. They match the implementers' b99d5507 and ffb6d976 (rebased; only .shop differs). Suite from the brief's record: 1097 passed, 0 failed.
Nothing changed under features/ and no test was removed. Both allowances (8 setup, 9 interim) hold.
Two Important findings, both fix now:
(1) is_scenario looks at module text, so tests/scripts modules that contain scenarios( are still rerun and taken back, against the person's ruling (only nodes under tests/scenarios/).
(2) -n 0 is always added to the rerun, so without xdist every rerun fails with 'unrecognized arguments: -n' and r222 never takes a scenario back.
Minor: the errors regex matches captured output (observation). Two ruff hits in supervise_merge.py (drop).
vulture clean, no import contracts, size clean.
questions: Important, scripts/supervise_merge.py:117-121: is_scenario looks at module text, so a FAILED node in tests/scripts/test_work_items.py, test_features_scenarios.py, test_features_deprecating.py or test_supervise_merge_rerun.py (all contain scenarios() is rerun and taken back, against the ruling 'only nodes under tests/scenarios/'; require the tests/scenarios/ path and move the r219/r222 fixture module (supervision_rerun_steps.py:39) there

Important, scripts/supervise_merge.py:137: '-n 0' is added to the rerun even when the command has no -n (no xdist, or a delivery's own tests), so the rerun exits 4 with 'unrecognized arguments: -n' and r222 never takes a scenario back; add it only where -n was given
